CareTria is seeking a driven and curious Junior Software Engineer to join its development team. The role focuses on building and enhancing modern web applications, developing frontend and backend features, working with databases and APIs, collaborating across teams, and using AI-assisted development tools responsibly.
Marketing
Pharmaceutical
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Build and maintain user-facing features using React and Next.js
Develop backend services and APIs with Node.js
Work with relational databases using SQL
Work with document databases such as MongoDB
Write clear, maintainable, and well-tested code
Fix bugs and investigate issues with support from the wider team
Participate in code reviews and learn how to give and receive constructive feedback
Collaborate with engineers, designers, product managers, and other colleagues
Use AI-assisted development tools to explore solutions, understand unfamiliar code, generate initial drafts, and improve productivity
Review, test, and validate AI-generated code rather than accepting it without question
Learn our development, testing, deployment, security, and monitoring practices
Contribute to technical documentation and share what you learn

Required
A basic understanding of JavaScript or TypeScript
Some experience with Node.js and React gained through study, personal projects, internships, a bootcamp, or previous work
Familiarity with Next.js, or an interest in learning it
A basic understanding of databases and experience with SQL, MongoDB, or both
Familiarity with Git and common software-development workflows
An understanding of fundamental web concepts such as HTTP, APIs, browser behavior, and client-server applications
An interest in using AI coding tools responsibly and effectively
The ability to explain your approach, ask questions, and seek help when needed
A willingness to learn from feedback and steadily improve your skills
Write clear prompts and provide useful technical context
Use AI to investigate problems, explain concepts, draft tests, and suggest implementations
Check generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability
Verify suggestions by reading documentation, running tests, and understanding the code before submitting it
Recognize when an AI-generated answer may be incomplete or incorrect
Protect confidential information and follow company policies when using AI tools
Preferred
Personal, academic, open-source, or bootcamp projects you can discuss
Experience with TypeScript
Familiarity with automated testing
Experience building or consuming REST or GraphQL APIs
Basic knowledge of cloud platforms, containers, CI/CD, or deployment workflows
An understanding of accessibility, web security, or responsive design
Benefits
Access to health, dental, and vision insurance
Retirement plan options
Paid time off
Paid parental leave
Employee assistance programs
Eligible employees may also have access to performance bonuses
